# v0.4.3 — local models, hardened router

Full changelog:
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cyberd4ch/txn-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

**Any OpenAI-compatible model can now run the loop — local models included.**
`txn_agent/llm_openai.py` speaks the OpenAI chat-completions wire format (stdlib
urllib, no SDK) and exposes the Anthropic-Messages surface the loop expects:

```bash
ollama serve
python -m txn_agent --llm "buy a drain pump under $70" \
    --llm-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --model qwen2.5:3b
```

**Live-verified with `qwen2.5:3b` on Ollama** (Apple M1): under-cap request →
search → build_cart → checkout_cart → **purchased, $64.74**, first try. A
multi-line over-cap restock saw the 3B model hallucinate offer ids, receive the
fail-soft error, recover, build the $160.73 cart — then stop and ask for approval.
Full transcript in `docs/architecture.md` → *Verification status*.

**Hardened against weak model output.** `ToolRouter` now fails soft: malformed tool
arguments and unparseable budgets (including `"$200"`-style strings, which now
parse and cap correctly) return a readable error into the loop instead of crashing
the run. Both behaviors found by the live smoke, both regression-tested.

**FAQ.** [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md) — the launch objections, answered from the code.

**67 tests · 86% coverage · ruff + mypy strict clean · assets built by CI from this tag**
